title: What actually happened this week

cells: Cloudflare now blocks AI agents by default, everywhere
From Sep 15, its recommended default blocks Agent crawlers only on ad-supported pages for new domains. Non-ad sites are recommended to allow them; existing settings are migrated, not overwritten.
Visa, Mastercard and Ant launched a universal agent-payment standard
They announced an early collaboration to explore shared Know-Your-Agent principles. Each network still runs its own verification and decisions.
A bipartisan Senate investigation is already prosecuting OpenAI
The inquiry was launched by Sen. Hawley's Republican-led subcommittee. It's an investigation request, not a bipartisan prosecution.

source: Cross-checked against Cloudflare, Visa/Mastercard/Ant and Sen. Hawley's own statements, 10-15 Sep 2026
